title: A Regiment for the Atlas
author: Orsen Pemberton
blurb: Freya Kavanagh, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
